title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)

Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.Du passt gut zu uns wennDu bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.Warum BuenaFrüh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.So lernen wir uns kennenWir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
description_clean: Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform CoreLocation: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, PermanentAbout FullEnrich:Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.About the Role:At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.What You'll Do:Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.What Success Looks LikeIn your first 3 months:Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.By 6 months:Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.By 12 months:Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.What We're Looking For:Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. What you will be doing As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
description_clean: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen. Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling. Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. What Makes You a Fit

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.
What We Offer
Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.  
Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. responders more time to protect communitiesPublishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.Compute: GPU resources are title: Senior Fullstack Developer .NET
description_clean: Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur.  Als Senior Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je vanzelfsprekend tussen frontend en backend, bouwt zelf mee aan nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd onze applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren.  Daarbij kijken we nadrukkelijk naar jou om technische richting en structuur te helpen aanbrengen. Niet door keuzes alleen te maken, maar juist door technische vraagstukken scherp te krijgen, verschillende perspectieven bij elkaar te brengen en samen met het team tot goede, gedragen oplossingen te komen.  1. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor je eigen code, maar kijkt ook naar de samenhang en kwaliteit van de oplossing als geheel. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:  ontwikkelen van nieuwe backendfunctionaliteit in C#/.NET; ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van frontendfunctionaliteit met één van de grote frontend frameworksontwerpen en verbeteren van API's, integraties en dataoplossingen; maken van technische ontwerpen die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden; schrijven en stimuleren van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code; bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps; analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar pragmatische oplossingen; aanbrengen van technische structuur en bewaken van samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie; richting geven aan architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes en inzichtelijk maken van de consequenties van verschillende opties; begeleiden van technische discussies en ervoor zorgen dat kennis en ideeën van andere teamleden worden meegenomen; ondersteunen van collega-developers bij complexe technische vraagstukken; herkennen en bespreekbaar maken van technische schuld, risico's en mogelijkheden voor verbetering; stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX.  Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.  Als senior developer help je het team om die afweging bewust te maken. Soms betekent dat investeren in een structurele technische verbetering, soms juist kiezen voor een pragmatische oplossing die past bij de situatie.  2. De technische uitdaging OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Daardoor werk je niet alleen aan de vraag: “Hoe bouwen we deze feature?” maar juist ook aan vragen als: “Hoe past deze oplossing in de rest van onze architectuur?” “Welke keuze helpt ons niet alleen vandaag, maar ook over een paar jaar?” “Hoe voorkomen we dat verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie ieder hun eigen richting opgaan?” En misschien nog belangrijker: “Hoe komen we als team tot een technische keuze waar verschillende inzichten goed in zijn meegenomen?”  Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat de beste technische oplossing zelden door één persoon wordt bedacht. Je zoekt actief de discussie met andere developers, luistert naar argumenten en gebruikt de expertise binnen het team om de uiteindelijke oplossing beter te maken.  Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer.  Technisch leiderschap betekent bij ons dus niet bepalen wat anderen moeten bouwen, maar richting geven, structuur aanbrengen en het team helpen betere technische keuzes te maken.  3. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een ervaren developer die zich daadwerkelijk thuis voelt aan beide kanten van de stack.  Voor deze seniorrol zoeken we dus niet naar een backenddeveloper die af en toe frontendwerk doet, of andersom. Je hoeft niet overal dezelfde diepgang te hebben, maar je bent in staat om zelfstandig aan zowel frontend als backend te werken en kunt technische vraagstukken over de volledige keten overzien. Je:  hebt een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau op het gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; hebt ruime professionele ervaring met C# en .NET; hebt ruime ervaring met moderne frontendontwikkeling en kunt zelfstandig werken met één van de grote frontend frameworks hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van API's en integraties; hebt gedegen kennis van databases en begrijpt hoe keuzes in de datalaag doorwerken naar backend en frontend; kunt technische oplossingen ontwerpen over meerdere lagen van een applicatie; hebt een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en kunt architectuurprincipes toepassen zonder de pragmatiek uit het oog te verliezen; hebt oog voor aspecten als onderhoudbaarheid, testbaarheid, performance, security en technische schuld; bent gewend te werken met CI/CD, automated testing en een Agile/Scrum-werkwijze; kunt complexe technische vraagstukken structureren en terugbrengen tot heldere keuzes; durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is en kunt duidelijk uitleggen waarom een bepaalde richting wordt gekozen; staat tegelijkertijd open voor andere inzichten en bent bereid je eigen oplossing ter discussie te stellen; helpt minder ervaren developers groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen naar oplossingen te zoeken; communiceert gemakkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's.  Wat maakt jou senior? Voor ons zit senioriteit niet alleen in het aantal jaren ervaring of hoeveel technologieën je beheerst. We zoeken iemand die over de grenzen van een individuele feature heen kijkt. Je ziet patronen en afhankelijkheden, herkent wanneer een technische keuze gevolgen heeft voor andere onderdelen van het systeem en brengt structuur aan wanneer een vraagstuk complex wordt. Je bent bovendien iemand naar wie collega's toe kunnen stappen wanneer een technisch vraagstuk vastloopt. Niet omdat je altijd direct het antwoord hebt, maar omdat je kunt helpen om het probleem scherp te krijgen en gezamenlijk tot een goede oplossing te komen. Daarbij kun je leiden zonder alles zelf te willen bepalen. Je geeft richting wanneer dat nodig is, maar creëert ook ruimte voor discussie, andere ideeën en de expertise van je collega's.  4. Waarom OrtaX? OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij investeren we in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie. Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de maatschappelijke toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt.  Voor een Senior Fullstack Developer betekent dat dat je niet alleen aansluit bij een bestaande technische omgeving, maar daadwerkelijk invloed kunt hebben op hoe OrtaX zich technisch verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt de ruimte om structuur aan te brengen, technische keuzes te helpen maken en verbeteringen in gang te zetten. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf dicht bij de techniek en bouw je mee aan de oplossingen die daaruit voortkomen.  Je krijgt daarmee de combinatie van een volwassen product, een stevige technische moderniseringsopgave en de mogelijkheid om samen met het team de technische koers verder vorm te geven.  5. description_clean: About RecareAs one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken.
Worum es geht
benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage: 
benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet.

Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort.
Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar.
Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament.

Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows.
Warum wir das machen
Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist.
Deine Aufgaben

Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows.
benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.
Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig.
Anforderungen schärfen: Du übersetzt den Bedarf der Teams in vollständige Anforderungen mit Problem, Ablauf, Nutzen und Abnahmekriterium und bringst sie in die Weiterentwicklung von benuta Nexus ein.
KI-Werkzeuge verantworten: Du führst unsere KI-gestützten Lösungen, etwa im Kundenservice und im Bewertungsmanagement, und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Ergebnisse dort ankommen, wo daraus Verbesserungen werden.
Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen.
Stellenanforderungen
Das bringst du mit
Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen.

Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat.
Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden.
Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt.
Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
Starke Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, überzeugst vor Gruppen und im Einzelgespräch und schreibst präzise.
Hands-on und Tempo: Du bist Macher, nicht Verwalter. Du packst selbst an, treibst Themen mit Energie voran und fühlst dich in einem hohen Tempo wohl.
Sprache: Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.
Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in E-Commerce, Handel oder Logistik sowie mit Modellen von Google, OpenAI oder Anthropic. Die Modelle bei uns sind gesetzt; entscheidend ist, was du damit im Prozess erreichst.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist
Wir suchen niemanden, der vor allem neue Tools einführt oder dessen KI-Erfahrung sich auf die Arbeit mit Chat-Assistenten beschränkt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lösungen baut: Prozesse versteht, automatisiert und messbar besser macht.

Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer gelebten AI-First-Strategie, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
Ein System, das schon steht und jetzt in die Breite muss. Du startest nicht bei null.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung eines KI-Projekts, das du selbst umgesetzt hast: Ausgangslage, dein Vorgehen, das Ergebnis in Zahlen und was du daraus gelernt hast. title: Senior Python Engineer - ERP (d/f/m)
description_clean:
Deine Mission
As Senior Python Engineer - ERP (d/f/m), you shape how our ERP grows. Odoo runs our invoicing, hardware logistics and energy market communication, and over the next year it becomes the source of truth for customer and contract data and takes over electricity billing. You design the data model and module architecture, build integrations with our platform and partners, and hold the quality bar for the team. You do not only ask "How do we build this in Odoo", but also "Should this live in Odoo at all".
Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Designing and building custom Odoo modules, from data model to UI
Making architecture decisions for a growing ERP, including what belongs in Odoo and what doesn’t
Driving the migration of customer, contract and metering processes from HubSpot into Odoo
Building and maintaining integrations with our internal platform and external partners in logistics, metering and market communication
Shipping features to production independently
Setting technical standards for code reviews, automated tests, CI and code quality
Reviewing code and pairing with our developers and our external Odoo partner
Working closely with Finance and Ops to turn their needs into clear scope and reliable estimates

Dein Profil

You bring 5+ years of software development
Several years working with Python and PostgreSQL
You’ve built integrations between systems (REST APIs, webhooks, batch jobs) that run reliably in production
Git, CI and automated tests are part of your daily routine
You think in data models and processes, not just in tickets
You raise risks early, say clearly when a deadline won’t hold and push back when needed, including with non-technical stakeholders
You speak fluent English

Unser Offer

Real influence on a core system: shape the ERP our whole business runs on
Impact on the energy transition: work powers billing, logistics and market communication for smart home energy
More room to shape things than at an Odoo agency or in a large corporate
Short paths to Finance, Ops and our CTO, no long chains of command
Flexibility: work remotely from anywhere in Germany or from our offices in Berlin and Cologne

description_clean: Since early 2024, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business, and through that to make a real dent in the world's carbon emissions and a far better experience for homeowners.We're now looking for a Design Engineer who wants to design & ship exceptional outcomes for users. Most of our product is a front end over hard physics (heat-loss calculations, hydronic design, LiDAR floor plans, compliance that has to be right), used by installers on a phone, with no signal, in a hurry. Making that feel simple is a design problem and an engineering problem at the same time, and this role sits right on that seam. 🌲 About SpruceAlmost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have grown the team 3x and revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, are launching an end-to-end solar and battery product in November, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed… 🥖 The roleYou'll own how the product looks, feels and behaves wherever installers use it, from the first sketch to the shipped feature. Installers only adopt Spruce if it's easy to use on a real job, and adoption is what drives our growth. That puts your work at the centre of the business. Day-to-day you'll be:Designing and shipping – You'll take a flow from rough idea all the way to production, prototyping in whatever gets you to an answer fastest (often code, sometimes Figma or a sketch), and testing with installers as you go. The gap between "we should fix this" and "it's fixed" is often a day.Owning the interaction layer – You'll build and look after the component library and the patterns underneath it: motion, loading and empty states, touch targets that still work with gloves on. LiDAR), the proposals homeowners see. You might currently call yourself a designer who ships, a front-end engineer with strong design instincts, or already a design engineer. We're looking for 3+ years of experience (and potentially a lot more) designing and building product UI, ideally in a startup or a fast-paced, impact-focussed team. description_clean: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vousLe Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de cinq ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Les travaux de la chaire incluent plusieurs doctorats et post-doctorats visant à faire progresser la connaissance du phénomène de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les aciers faiblement alliés et de la fragilisation associée, ainsi qu’à développer de nouvelles méthodologies de mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire, ou à améliorer les méthodologies existantes.Le post-doc proposé ici, financé par EDF, vise à déterminer l'effet de l'irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire, pour les matériaux suivis dans le cadre du programme de surveillance des effets de l'irradiation sur les matériaux des cuves REP d'EDF. Il est en effet important de savoir si de la fragilisation intergranulaire peut intervenir à forte fluence pour prévoir correctement l'évolution des propriétés de rupture. C'est donc une caractérisation qui vient en appui de l'interprétation des fragilisations mesurées dans le cadre du programme de surveillance. Le travail consistera à mesurer les états de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les états non irradié et irradié en utilisant la microscopie électronique en transmission (STEM-EDX). Contrairement à la spectroscopie Auger, la microscopie électronique ne nécessite pas l'obtention d'une surface de rupture sous ultra-vide, ce qui constitue un avantage pour des matériaux dont la tendance à la rupture intergranulaire est faible. L'acier de cuve a une certaine hétérogénéité de composition chimique locale à cause de la présence de mésoségrégations enrichies en solutés majeurs et en impuretés fragilisantes comme le phosphore. Pour juger des seuls effets de l'irradiation, les zones d'analyse en microscopie électronique devront donc être équivalentes en termes d'intensité de mésoségrégation dans les états non irradié et irradié. Ceci nécessitera une caractérisation préalable des mésoségrégations et un prélèvement ciblé des lames minces en zone ségrégée ou en zone non ségrégée par faisceau d'ions focalisés (FIB). We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.

Publications at top-tier conferences.
Experience in managing a software team.
Ability to write production-level code in modern C++

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.
We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.
Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.What you’ll own in your first yearYou won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.
YOUR IMPACT

Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.
Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 
WHO YOU ARE

You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus
You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours)
A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.
A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.
A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.
A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 
At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners. 
What makes our team unique:

Our global Security team aspires to be the world's most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).
We're shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our "classic" platforms of the three companies.
The greater team is not just information security - we're more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.

 
This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany, or Helsinki, Finland, and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.
 
Day-to-day in this role you'll:
 

Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.
Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build "paved paths" that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.
Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.
Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.
Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.
Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.
Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.
Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

 
Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is  a large place and there's a lot to do!
 
As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. On-call compensation and terms will be agreed separately in accordance with the local employment law.
 
Our humble expectations* 

Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company's infrastructure security posture.
Breadth of technical experience across various infrastructure and security areas running in large production environments.
Highly skilled in distributed systems and platforms development using program languages such as Java/Scala/Kotlin, Golang, or Python.
Strong experience with infrastructure as a code tooling like Terraform.
Expertise with cloud infrastructure and management in AWS.
Experience solving complex, systemic issues that require creative thinking and solutions.
Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to review design documents with respect to cloud infrastructure, security and engineering personnel.
Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.

Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really want to join us!Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description_clean:
Company Description
Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.
Job Overview
Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
Your Tasks

Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service.
Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

Your Profile

Strong hands-on software engineering background (10+ years) with deep expertise in common programming languages. We use Java, Python, and Typescript.
Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments.
Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions.
Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.
Experience with React and TypeScript frontend development is a plus.

Our Offer

Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
FinTech Excellence: Experience the cutting-edge world of FinTech at Solactive.
Modern Culture: Thrive in our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
Responsibility & Connections: Take responsibility from day one and build valuable relationships both inside and outside the company.
Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of annual vacation, plus additional time off for Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
Community & Networking: Participate in our various networking events, tech talks, and business talks.
Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offerings.
Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
description_clean:
About The Company
At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.
Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.
NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.
We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.
The Role and What Makes It Special
You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.
This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.
There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.
You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.
Tasks
What You'll Do
PR & Events

Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements
What We're Looking For
(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper

Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.In practice, your week splits two ways. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description_clean:
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.
From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You'll Be Doing
You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.
Here's what your day-to-day might look like:


Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.


Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.


Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.


Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.


Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.


Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.


Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.


What You'll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:


Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.


Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.


Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.


Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.


Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.


Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.


Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.


Nice to have


Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.


Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.


Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.


Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.


Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.


Why Join Us?
At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.
We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scaleWork on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
🌱 See your impact, fastShip, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
🧠 Grow through challenge and ownershipTake on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
🌎 A culture built for buildersHigh standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
💰 Share in the success you help createCompetitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.
➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine, our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.Diversity, Equity and InclusionAt Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
description_clean: Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zoneHi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.— GrigoryWhy Secfix existsOver 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.What you'll actually do in the first 3 monthsThis isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next manager.AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.What success looks likeAt 6 months: The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality. Our agentic engineering playbook is noticeably better because of you — you’ve added or rewritten the skills, rules, and AI review checks the team uses every day, and you lead by example in how you ship with agents.At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've found and/or coached the EM Nr. 2 to support growth.How we workWe've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here.Zero-bugs. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product.We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. But you're not scared of jumping into a pair programming session either.What we're looking forRequired8+ years as a software engineer, including 4+ years managing a team of 8+ and hiring for it yourselfYou've shipped AI features to production — retrieval, RAG, agentic workflows — and you know the difference between a demo that works and one that holds up on real customer dataProduct taste: a keen sense for what makes a product feel great, and the habit of saying so when it doesn'tYou've built and shipped with Claude Code and Cursor in real production work, and you have opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debtYou're an engineer at heart.
